summary: [Meta Marketing API] idempotency: No native idempotency-key on campaign/ad creation in retrieved docs. Client-side: name-based pre-checks (list campaigns/adsets by name before create), record returned ids, reconcile on timeout before re-POST. Batch API executes sub-requests in order with per-op results: use dependent references instead of separate calls to avoid partial creation.
followup: Verify current Meta idempotency guidance at build time.
